notes.title: We’re heading to Gamescom 🐾
notes.content:
[h3]🐈 Sharpen them claws, wrap up that nap, and prepare to pounce on our demo![/h3]

We’re excited to be bringing Catrophy Trail back to Gamescom!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224060/Catrophy_Trail/

[b]Gamescom will take place at Koelnmesse, Cologne from August 21st to August 25th.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345139/f13d16d010f673bc836fd215b3c306f6c635616e.jpg[/img]

If you’re at the event, come find us at Hall 10, Edmonton Screen Industries zone (Stand E040) and chat with Jesse from the team.

[h3]
If you can’t wait to fill your wagon with more cat content, follow us on social media and join our Discord 😸[/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XgnVuKsxQm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345139/f8e83e4c7d3d5afee651f9ece36f983412135727.png[/img][/url]
